layout_summary: A full-height white page split vertically: a tilted desk globe bleeding off the left edge whose brass meridian arc melts into a stream of warm gold that pours into a plain purple Kapruka gift bag occupying the lower-left column, and a four-line movie-poster title stack parked in the right half at mid-height. One Kapruka logo sits quietly in the lower-right field, and a single wide tagline line runs across the bottom edge, centred on the canvas.

scene.subject: A vintage desk globe — matte deep-purple oceans, raised warm-gold landmasses in genuine relief, completely unmarked — tilted and cropped so its left side runs off the left edge of the page; its slender antique-brass meridian arc runs down from the globe's base and partway down stops being metal and turns molten, pouring as a thick stream of warm gold that splits into three claw-like prongs and lands in the open mouth of a squat matte purple paper gift bag with white twisted-rope handles, which is overflowing — gold slumps over the rim and runs down the far left and right edges of the bag, pooling in a small blob beside the base. Rising from the bag's mouth: fresh red roses and a gold-cased wristwatch hooked over the rim. The bag is painted plain and blank — no logo, wordmark, text, smile arc or pattern — with its flat front panel left clean and clearly visible for the real logo to be placed in Canva afterwards.
scene.composition: Single left-hand column. Globe occupies the upper third (y 10.5–45.5%), tilted roughly 30° with its axis high-right and its body exiting frame at left between y=37% and y=45.5%; its widest point reaches x=35.5% at y=25%. The melting arc runs from y=33% down to a three-pronged fork at y=48–54.5%. The bag sits bottom-left, x 14–35%, y 56–82.5%, upright and frontal, roughly 21% of canvas width. Scene and type never overlap — the globe's right extremity (35.5%) clears the headline's left edge (47%) by 11.5%.
scene.camera: Eye-level to very slightly above the bag, straight-on frontal product view with a long-lens flat perspective (minimal convergence on the bag's front panel). Deep focus throughout — every edge sharp, no depth-of-field falloff, no visible lens distortion.
scene.lighting: Bright, even high-key studio lighting on a pure white seamless ground. Key high and slightly front-left (highlight runs along the globe's upper curve and the left shoulder of the bag), with broad fill from the right killing almost all cast shadow — only a faint soft contact shadow under the bag base. Specular highlights hard and mirror-like on the brass arc, soft and waxy on the molten gold, matte on the paper bag. Neutral-white colour temperature; no colour cast.

scene.prompt: High-key product still life on a pure white seamless studio ground. 4:5 portrait. Left column only. Upper left: a vintage desk globe, tilted, cropped so its left side runs off the left edge — matte deep-purple oceans, raised warm-gold landmasses in genuine relief with no markings, borders or engraving, and a slender antique-brass meridian arc curving down from its base. Partway down the arc stops being metal and becomes a thick molten stream of warm liquid gold that forks into three pointed prongs and falls into the open mouth of a squat matte purple paper shopping bag with white twisted-rope handles, upright and frontal in the lower left. The bag is plain and unprinted, no marks, pattern or decoration, its flat front panel clean and clearly visible; gold slumps over the rim and runs down only the far left and right edges, pooling in one small blob beside the base. Rising from the bag's mouth: fresh red roses and a gold-cased wristwatch hooked over the rim. Light: bright, even, high-key; key high and slightly front-left, broad fill from the right; no cast shadow except a faint contact shadow under the bag. Long lens, straight-on, eye-level, deep focus, every edge sharp. Real brass, paper, petals and metal; real contact shadows; fine natural grain; no plastic sheen, no CG look. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, words, logos, watermarks, labels, signage or UI anywhere, including on the bag, globe and products. Keep empty and calm white: x 36-100% / y 0-31%; x 47-91% / y 31-55%; x 36-100% / y 55-92%; full width y 92-100%.

why_it_works: Hard diagonal split: all imagery is locked into the left 35% and all type into the right 47–90.5%, so neither ever competes — the eye reads picture, then title, then tagline with no overlap to untangle.

The melting meridian arc is a single continuous line from the top-left corner down to the bag at 82% — it drags the eye the full height of the frame and physically connects the world to the Kapruka bag, which is the claim the tagline makes in words.

Only two tones do any work on a pure white ground (Retail Purple and near-black Deep Purple), so the purple globe at top-left and the purple tagline at the bottom bracket the layout and make the near-black title stack the sole mid-page stop; all warmth is spent on the gold pour, where the product story is.
changes: Subject swap, device kept exactly: red stiletto → tilted purple desk globe cropped off the left edge; Biscoff jar → plain Kapruka purple gift bag; caramel → molten warm gold. The trick is unchanged — a thin stem melts, forks into three prongs, and the vessel below overflows. Every box, crop, camera and light value held.

Scene rendered as photography, not a glossy 3D render — brand guidelines ban glossy 3D/plastic-looking product scenes. Composition, framing (cutout-on-ground), camera and high-key studio light are unchanged.
Copy swapped line-for-line inside the ±15% character limit: THE (3 vs 3) / GIFTS (5 vs DEVIL 5) / THAT (4 vs EATS 4) / ARRIVE (6 vs BISCOFF 7). Plain spoken words, no wordplay.

The bottom caption slot carries the brand tagline 'A world of choices' on its own, since the measured role is 'tagline' and the tagline may never be extended into a sentence. It is shorter than the reference line, so the fixed box cannot overflow; box, size, weight and centring on x=50% are unchanged.

Didot → Poppins 700 across all five text blocks (brand guidelines' headline face, and on the Canva list). Every size_px, cap height, case, letter-spacing, line-height, alignment and line count is held exactly, so the rhythm of the stack survives the face change.

Colour roles mapped: reference near-black hero lines → Deep Purple #241044; reference crimson accent lines and caption → Retail Purple #340A5C. Gold and yellow are deliberately kept out of type on a white ground (too low in contrast, and strokes to rescue them are banned) — the warm accent lives in the gold pour instead.
The devil's-tail arrow on the 'I' is deleted — no ornaments, strokes or swooshes as shapes. The three-pronged drip stays, because it is part of the photographed scene, not a graphic layer.

One Kapruka logo added in the calmest corner (lower-right, x 71.5–90.5% / y 78–83%), right edge sitting on the title block's existing 90.5% axis, inside the 9.5% right margin, on light. The reference had none. The bag itself stays plain blank purple with its front panel clear, per the packaging rule; scene.attach = [].
claims_used: 'GIFTS' — Kapruka is Sri Lanka's largest locally-owned e-commerce and gifting platform; Gifting is Line A (01-business-context.md §1 'What Kapruka Is', §2 'Line A — Gifting').

'ARRIVE' — the moat: reliable, island-wide delivery on a date the buyer chooses, backed by 'millions of gifts delivered' (01-business-context.md §1, CONFIRMED PROOF block, approved for ad use 2026-07-04). No specific speed, date or route is promised in the copy.

'A world of choices' — the approved default brand-level tagline (_brand-assets.md, human decision 2026-07-18), and supported by the business fact that Kapruka delivers 'from anywhere in the world to anywhere in Sri Lanka' (01-business-context.md §1).

The globe as the scene's icon — supported by 'from anywhere in the world to anywhere in Sri Lanka' and the named diaspora markets Australia, USA, Canada, UAE (01-business-context.md §1 CONFIRMED PROOF). It is an icon, not a claim of global shipping.

The gifts in frame (fresh red roses + a gold-cased wristwatch) — two separate departments, per the confirmed top gifting categories (flowers) and the wider catalogue (jewellery & watches); real, finished, sellable gifts, no SKU, price or offer stated (01-business-context.md §6 item 7; CLAUDE.md Core Rule 12).

No delivery-speed, price, discount or offer claim appears anywhere in the copy — the scope rule 'no product/offer advertising until the human flags one' is respected (01-business-context.md §2 Line C note; CLAUDE.md scope).
